description: A note, leader, element tag or dimension on a drawing: drawing plan (a level's plan: level) or south|north|east|west|section-ew|section-ns. Positions are plan points in mm with height above the level floor (mm, default 0): at (where text goes), tip (what a leader or tag points at; element: the tagged element's id), points (2 or more, for a dimension string measured along the line through the first two; offset: how far to its side, mm, default 600). size: text height on paper, mm (2.5, 3.5 default, 5, 7). They show on the sheets and exports.
name: add_drawing_note
title: Annotate a drawing
